comparison.objective: Polish both faces of a blank on a running buffing wheel without snatch, then rack it; candidate calibrates proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-controlled surface contact, sweeping coverage, reorientation, and snatch avoidance versus fine slide-and-lock adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Both faces need sufficient pressed-contact coverage, no snatch/fling, and safe released racking; candidate needs two ≤6 mm over-center registrations.
comparison.reason: The objectives, dynamic contact physics, hazards, and success evidence are unrelated. Candidate still lacks tightening-force and drift thresholds.
